title: Area comparison and null-set transfer along a continuous graph piece dominated by a measure
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, q a linear isometry of R^(n+l), Omega a Borel subset of R^n, u : R^n -> R^l continuous on Omega, F(x) := q(graphPoint(x, u(x))), Gamma := q(graph u over Omega) = F(Omega), and nu a measure on R^(n+l) with H^n restricted to Gamma <= nu (H^n = muHE[n]). Then (a) for every Borel A contained in Omega, q(graph u over A) = F(A) is Borel; (b) for every Borel A contained in Omega and every Borel g : R^(n+l) -> [0, infinity], the integral over A of g(F(x)) dL^n(x) is at most the integral over q(graph u over A) of g dnu; (c) for every property P of points of R^(n+l) that holds nu-a.e., P(F(x)) holds for L^n-a.e. x in Omega.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (Ω : Set (Rn n)), MeasurableSet Ω → ContinuousOn u Ω → ∀ ν : Measure (Amb n ℓ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (q '' graphOver u Ω) ≤ ν → (∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ Ω → MeasurableSet (q '' graphOver u A)) ∧ (∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ Ω → ∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ x in A, g (q (graphPoint x (u x))) ≤ ∫⁻ y in q '' graphOver u A, g y ∂ν) ∧ ∀ P : Amb n ℓ → Prop, (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, P y) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), P (q (graphPoint x (u x)))
